newsitem.title: UK: Four EU green rates to devalue on Sunday-HGCA.
newsitem.headline: Four EU green rates to devalue on Sunday-HGCA.

text.p: The green rates of the Dutch guilder, Spanish peseta, Swedish crown and Austrian schilling will be devalued with effect from Sunday, the UK's Home Grown Cereals Authority (HGCA) said on Friday.

The green guilder is to devalue to 2.19831 per Ecu from 2.19514 per Ecu, the green peseta is to devalue to 165.571 per ecu from 165.442, the green Swedish crown is to devalue to 8.71269 per Ecu from 8.69363 and the green Austrian schilling to devalue to 13.7529 per Ecu from 13.7526.
Also on Sunday, sterling and the Irish pound will enter the fourth of five possible confirmation periods ahead of a revaluation on March 29, the HGCA said.
Green rates are used by the European Union (EU) to convert Ecu into the currencies of its member stats in its Common Agricultural Policy.
